name: Supplication
overview: Scripture teaches that supplication is a vital, persistent practice in the believer's life, characterized by earnest prayer and making requests known to God with thanksgiving, as seen in Philippians 4:6 and Ephesians 6:18. This intimate communication flows from dwelling in God's presence, the 'secret place of the Most High,' where believers find refuge and strength (Psalms 91:1). Jesus models this in the Lord's Prayer, emphasizing reverence and continual dependence on the Father (Matthew 6:9; Luke 18:1). Ultimately, God promises to supply every need according to His riches in glory through Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19), encouraging believers to approach Him confidently and persistently in supplication.
